task: Implement export_data for the analytics system without using data warehouse export behavior.

candidate_memories.content: Analytics export_data queries the event aggregation store and streams results as NDJSON.
Analytics exports are streaming; they must not load the full result set into memory before writing.
Export format is NDJSON per contract with downstream pipeline consumers.
When export_data spans analytics and data warehouse, verify the streaming vs batch model first.
Data warehouse: export_data runs a full table scan, serializes to Parquet, and uploads to S3.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: batch Parquet export model conflicts with the streaming NDJSON analytics requirement

candidate_memories.content: Old data note says export_data should be unified so one function handles both streaming and batch.
